title: Clean DCP Linear Witness Identities, Carry Conditions, and Conditioned-Label Controls

theorems.statement: For every t >= 2 and every A in Z_{2^t}^{n x K} with an odd-determinant n x n pivot block A_P in GL_n(Z_{2^t}), the deterministic 2-adic witness map w_P(t) = A_P^{-1}(t - A_{bar{P}} u_0) mod 2^t lands in {0,1}^K for exactly 2^n of the 2^{nt} targets (verified coverage beta_A = 2^{-n(t-1)}, direct-filter success 2^{-(K-nt)} 2^{-2n(t-1)}), and for the parity target h = (2^{t-1}, 0, ..., 0) satisfies T_valid intersect (T_valid + h) = empty, yielding an identically zero forward-SWAP observable (Adv_SWAP = 0) across all secrets S in Z_{2^t}^n.

For any F_2-right inverse R_{F_2} in F_2^{K x (nt)} of the stacked bit-matrix M_{F_2} in F_2^{(nt) x K}, the CNOT witness candidate w(t) = R_{F_2} bits(t) mod 2 in {0,1}^K satisfies (A w(t))_ell^{(b)} = t_ell^{(b)} XOR (c_ell^{(b)}(w(t)) mod 2), so A w(t) = t mod 2^t holds if and only if all n(t-1) intermediate carry parities c_ell^{(b)}(w(t)) mod 2 vanish simultaneously.

Pairwise-disjoint nonzero directions of weight >=2 give m <= floor(K/2) and exact affine Boolean subset-sum linearization. Effective columns are even because the directions lie in ker(A mod 2). They cannot be IID uniform on the full group. No source-average advantage decay is established; finite conditional parity overlap and the probability 2^(m-K) of selecting one affine subspace are recorded separately.
